### The Sun Stands Still
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/the-sun-stands-still
Passage: Joshua 10:1-15
Points:
- Joshua honored Israel's treaty with Gibeon and marched to defend the city against a coalition of Amorite kings.
- The Lord assured Joshua of victory and intervened directly, throwing the enemy into panic and sending devastating hailstones.
- In answer to Joshua's bold prayer, God miraculously extended the day so Israel could complete the rout of their enemies.
- The biblical description reflects observational language from the human perspective rather than faulty cosmology.
- God continues fighting for His people today through Jesus Christ, ensuring the gospel advances and His church prevails.
